name: Nakazawa Tomoka
source:
Tomoka is the childhood friend of [url=/c82665]Kazuki[/url] and one of his classmate. Currently, her closest friend is [url=/c10662]Saki[/url], another gal. When she was a kid, she was the "Yamato Nadeshiko" type of girl. They was good friends before and Kazuki even propose to her, but since they start middle school, she becames more distant to him and she adopted the gyaru life style.

Kazuki doesn't know if he loves her anymore and secretly hope she didn't became an easy girl. He hopes to be close to her like before.

[spoiler]Her personality and her background story are differents depending the route followed. In a route she's slutty and in the other she's more romantic and innocent.
[/spoiler]
